I'm rescuing another John K Pe-ta thing from MTL hell. Again, I want to be very clear, I'm only doing this because I was given a decensored Raw.

Just doubling down on this, the ONLY reason I considered this was because someone gave me the raws for free, and I wanted to return that good deed to the community.
